professionalExperience.description: Maintain public safety by providing armed policing presence to Perth Central Business District, in collaboration with external agencies. Conduct thorough investigations and present evidence to the Courts.
responsibilities: Respond to emergency calls and provide assistance to the public.
Conduct investigations and gather evidence for criminal cases.
Collaborate with other law enforcement agencies to ensure public safety.

professionalExperience.description: Provide specialist roads policing presence to promote road safety and disrupt criminal activity. Respond to traffic incidents and collisions of all severities. Emergency scene management and investigation.
responsibilities: Manage scenes of serious-injury and fatal collisions
Pursue and apprehend criminal road users
Provide specialist advice to other policing teams

professionalExperience.description: Awarded City & Guilds Level 3 Certificate in Learning and Development. All responsibilities of Tactical Flight Officer (below), as well as training and assessment of Constables new to the Tactical Flight Officer role; ongoing development and support of colleagues; and periodical assessment of colleagues in various disciplines including air support operations, crew resource management, use of emergency and safety equipment, and use of night vision imaging systems (NVIS).
responsibilities: Deliver training and assess performance of individuals
Design and produce nationally implemented training material
Proactively seek opportunities to educate policing departments and external agencies on the capabilities and benefits of air support
Adapt delivery to meet individual learning styles
